name: GitHub
description: Posts GitHub issue and pull request events into a forum, one thread each, and creates issues from the chat with /issue.

requested_grants.purpose: Create one forum post per issue or pull request and answer /issue in it

data_egress: Issue and pull request events of the configured repositories are posted into the forum. /issue sends the title and the description to the configured GitHub API. With messages:read and events:subscribe, messages of people in linked threads go to GitHub as comments, with their display name.
